thesis.text: Regressions relating levels of highly autocorrelated or near-random-walk economic time series can yield high R2 values and apparently significant coefficients even when the variables are independent; such regressions are spurious, and strongly autocorrelated residuals indicate mis-specification.

citations.context: The recent experience of one of us [see Box and Newbold (1971)] has indicated just how easily one can be led to produce a spurious model if sufficient care is not taken over an appropriate formulation for the autocorrelation structure of the errors from the regression equation.
